value.contract: Source-derived finite numbers, strings, and hashes are inlined only when identical across selected engine profiles and registered by an unconditional core Lua table. Equal literals from feature-gated or unknown registration scopes use a generated stable-ID universal call through the Lua adapter with mechanically derived runtime-profile availability; profile-unavailable declarations retain that route and carry a machine-readable availability blocker, while truly impossible declarations fail closed.
